tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Latar halaman (krem kertas). Dasar semua layar.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Kartu, sheet, tombol sekunder, pilihan jawaban.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Area cekung: track progress bar, slot kosong susun kata, node terkunci.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Garis pinggir kartu & pilihan jawaban, pembatas.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Tepi bawah 3D kartu/pilihan; pinggir kontrol saat hover.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Teks utama di surface-000/100/200. Juga warna teks Arab pelajaran.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Teks sekunder, caption, terjemahan di bawah teks Arab. Lolos 4.5:1 di surface-000 & 100 kedua tema.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: HANYA ikon non-esensial, placeholder ≥ 18px, dan elemen terkunci. Jangan untuk teks kecil (≈3:1).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Warna Midad — tinta teal. Tombol utama, node aktif, progress, link. Maks satu aksi brand per layar.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Tepi bawah 3D tombol brand dan state pressed. Bukan untuk teks di tema gelap (pakai brand-ink).

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Latar pilihan terpilih, chip info, highlight lembut.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Teks/ikon brand di atas brand-soft (≥ 6:1 kedua tema).

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Teks & ikon di atas brand. Jangan pakai putih langsung di tema gelap.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Hadiah: XP, level naik, mahkota, peti harta. Jangan untuk status error/peringatan.

tokens.name: gold-strong
tokens.usage: Tepi bawah 3D tombol emas, outline bintang.

tokens.name: gold-soft
tokens.usage: Latar banner hadiah, kartu XP.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Teks di atas gold.

tokens.name: date
tokens.usage: Kurma (Tamr) — mata uang dalam app. Ikon & angka saldo kurma, toko avatar.

tokens.name: date-soft
tokens.usage: Latar pill saldo kurma, kartu item toko.

tokens.name: lantern
tokens.usage: Fanus (lentera) — streak harian. Fill ikon lentera saja; angka streak pakai lantern-ink.

tokens.name: lantern-soft
tokens.usage: Latar pill streak, kalender streak.

tokens.name: lantern-ink
tokens.usage: Angka streak di lantern-soft / surface-100. Ikon lentera tetap pakai lantern.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Jawaban benar: tombol Lanjut di sheet benar, centang. Selalu disertai ikon ✓.

tokens.name: success-strong
tokens.usage: Tepi bawah 3D tombol sukses.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Latar sheet benar & pilihan benar.

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Teks judul di success-soft (≥ 4.5:1).

tokens.name: on-success
tokens.usage: Teks di atas success fill (tombol LANJUT).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Jawaban salah, nyawa berkurang. Koral, bukan merah keras. Selalu disertai ikon ✕.

tokens.name: danger-strong
tokens.usage: Tepi bawah 3D tombol di sheet salah.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Latar sheet salah & pilihan salah.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Teks di danger-soft (≥ 4.5:1).

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Teks di atas danger fill (tombol besar ≥ 16px bold).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Cincin fokus keyboard 3px, offset 2px. Satu-satunya biru di sistem.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Latar gelap di belakang modal/bottom sheet.

families.arabic-ui: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "Noto Sans Arabic", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Judul layar, nama unit di peta.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta info. Ukuran minimum teks Arab UI.

styles.name: ar-hero
styles.usage: Satu kata di kartu kosakata / soal dengar.

styles.name: tr-md
styles.usage: Terjemahan di bawah ar-lg / ar-md / title. Warna ink-muted.

styles.name: tr-sm
styles.usage: Terjemahan di bawah teks UI (body, label, caption).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Jarak ikon–angka di pill.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap antar tile susun kata, jarak label kecil.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap antar pilihan jawaban, padding pill.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding kartu & pilihan jawaban, margin tepi layar HP.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Padding horizontal tombol.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Jarak antar section, padding sheet feedback.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Jarak instruksi ke area soal.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Jarak vertikal antar node di peta.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Tinggi minimum area sentuh.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Ruang kosong di layar selebrasi.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chip kecil, badge, tooltip.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Tombol, tile susun kata, pilihan jawaban.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Kartu, kartu item toko.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Sheet feedback (sudut atas), modal.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pill statistik, progress bar, node peta (lingkaran).

shadow.note: Midad memakai 'tepi 3D' (bayangan padat ke bawah tanpa blur) seperti tombol fisik yang bisa ditekan. Blur hanya untuk overlay.

tokens.name: edge-card
tokens.usage: Kartu, pilihan jawaban default, tile.

tokens.name: edge-brand
tokens.usage: Tombol utama & node peta aktif.

tokens.name: edge-gold
tokens.usage: Tombol hadiah, node peti harta.

tokens.name: edge-success
tokens.usage: Tombol Lanjut di sheet benar.

tokens.name: edge-danger
tokens.usage: Tombol Mengerti di sheet salah.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Modal, popover, toast.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Area sentuh minimum semua kontrol.

tokens.name: button-h
tokens.usage: Tinggi tombol standar.

tokens.name: node-size
tokens.usage: Diameter node pelajaran di peta.

tokens.name: screen-max
tokens.usage: Lebar maksimum kolom konten (layout HP-first, ditengahkan di desktop).
